description: Java class implementing a Vert.x based protocol adapter for Eclipse Hono, specifically for handling MQTT messages from Eclipse Kura gateways. It maps MQTT topics to Hono resource identifiers, handles message publishing, and distinguishes control and data messages based on topic prefixes and QoS levels.

classes.name: KuraProtocolAdapter
classes.description: A final class extending an abstract MQTT protocol adapter, implementing message mapping and publishing logic for Eclipse Kura gateways within Eclipse Hono.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name of the adapter, which is a constant indicating 'kura'.

methods.name: onPublishedMessage
methods.description: Handles the event of a message being published, mapping the MQTT topic and uploading the message, with error handling.

methods.name: mapTopic
methods.description: Maps an MQTT topic to a Hono resource identifier, differentiating control and data messages based on topic prefix and QoS, and validates topic format.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Determines the endpoint string ('telemetry' or 'event') based on MQTT QoS level.
